answer: I ran one Bell-state job on garnet:mock with 100 shots. The circuit put H on qubit 0, a CNOT from qubit 0 to qubit 1, and measured both qubits. The job ID is 01a15f17-9d55-7053-90ea-6fcb83050514 and it succeeded. The counts were 00: 30, 01: 23, 10: 20, and 11: 27. The bitstrings use Qiskit little-endian order. The mock returns random results, so all four outcomes appear. A real QPU should return mostly 00 and 11. I sent no real QPU jobs, so this run used no credits.
